(() => { const sels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#chat-scroll .question-select')).filter(s => !s.disabled); for (const sel of sels.reverse()) { const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改'); if (!opt) continue; sel.value = opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; } return false; })()
